edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Black Shield banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Track Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, falling to 7s at rank 5 — no engage while it's down. Bank E Black Shield for it; your own Q is down 10s if you miss, so land it on the punish, not the poke.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: W the puddle before he taunts, then bank Q — Justice Punch is 650 range, hold until he commits.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Poking Q into his 650-range Justice Punch — a landed E taunt through Black Shield sets up his ADC's kill.

edits.before: Ahead, legislate: root Galio's carry per window and shield the recovery engages away.
edits.after: Ahead, root Justice Punch's target on commit, punish the whiff — his R won't save him in time.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Q binds the diver who follows a knockup — 10s cooldown into a locked target, easy to convert.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Justice Punch is a 650-range dash — don't bait at its edge. If he Flashes the whiff, yours won't outrange it.
Colossal Smash (P) is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is your cue to back off, not the ability cast, since his combo opens with it.
